description: Complete active registry for every bounded, unsupported, excluded, or falsified claim in data/registry/unified_framework_claims.json. It does not claim automatic coverage of arbitrary prose outside that bounded canonical ledger. Falsified claims remain as lineage for explicitly new replacement hypotheses.

promotion_policy.paper_admission_rule: A computational or empirical hypothesis result may enter the manuscript only when its locked decision rule is evaluated and paper_promotion is eligible or promoted.
promotion_policy.independent_reproduction_rule: Every supported or negative computational or empirical result requires a cache-isolated rerun in a pinned clean environment, with separate runner and reviewer roles, before promotion. This gate establishes computational repeatability, not external replication or an independent implementation.
promotion_policy.literature_rule: Literature is admitted only when it directly defines, constrains, tests, or falsifies a registered hypothesis; literature cannot substitute for repository evidence.

hypotheses.title: Higher Cayley-Dickson zero-divisor observable
hypotheses.formal_statement: For declared state spaces X_ZD and X_0, dynamics Phi_t, and measurement Y, an intervention that changes only zero-divisor structure produces a nonzero preregistered contrast E[Y(Phi_t(X_ZD)) - Y(Phi_t(X_0))].

observable_predictions.observable: Matched difference in the declared response Y
observable_predictions.expected_relation: The confidence interval excludes zero and exceeds the preregistered minimum effect.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Run identical dynamics on algebraic and algebra-free states matched for spectrum, energy, dimension, parameter count, and conditioning.

controls: Algebra-free state with matched spectrum and energy
falsification_thresholds: Falsify the physical mapping if the corrected 95 percent confidence interval contains zero.
Falsify specificity if any matched surrogate reproduces the effect within the preregistered equivalence margin.

required_evidence.description: Typed physical state map, intervention, dynamics, observable, units, and nuisance parameters
Algebra-to-observable mechanism with dimensional consistency
Matched algebra-free and scrambled-label controls
Algebraic boundary and zero-divisor foundations
Independent reproduction after a primary result exists

hypotheses.title: Finite E10 or E11 supergravity dictionary
hypotheses.formal_statement: For a fixed algebra, level or height cutoff L, and explicit dictionary phi_L, every declared algebraic equation maps to the named supergravity equation through L, with the first unmatched term recorded.

observable_predictions.observable: Symbolic residual of each mapped equation through cutoff L
observable_predictions.expected_relation: Every in-scope residual simplifies exactly to zero and the first out-of-scope mismatch is identified.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Evaluate the locked dictionary symbolically and compare term-by-term with the declared supergravity truncation.

controls: Competing dictionary with the same number of free correspondences
falsification_thresholds: One nonzero exact residual within the declared cutoff falsifies the stated dictionary.
Instability of previously matched terms when L is increased falsifies truncation stability.

required_evidence.description: Explicit algebra, real form, truncation, variables, and typed dictionary
Term-by-term symbolic equation map
Foundational E10 and E11 supergravity proposals
Dictionary specificity controls
Independent symbolic reproduction

hypotheses.title: Moonshine-specific stability operator
hypotheses.formal_statement: A declared Monster representation rho and evolution U_t preserve a named invariant and improve a preregistered stability functional relative to equal-dimensional non-Monster controls.

observable_predictions.observable: Difference in the declared Lyapunov or norm-growth bound
observable_predictions.expected_relation: The Monster construction improves the bound beyond the locked minimum margin.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Evaluate the same evolution and perturbation ensemble under Monster, non-Monster, and label-shuffled representations.

falsification_thresholds: Failure of the claimed commutation or invariant relation falsifies the mechanism.
A corrected confidence interval overlapping the locked equivalence margin falsifies a stability advantage.

required_evidence.description: Representation, evolution, invariant, perturbation ensemble, and stability functional
Proof linking the representation to the stability inequality
Moonshine theorem and modern representation foundations
Equal-capacity alternative representation controls
Independent computational reproduction

hypotheses.title: Fractal estimator convergence under refinement
hypotheses.formal_statement: For exact-dimension controls and declared estimators, absolute error decreases under resolution refinement and remains stable under adjacent scale-window choices.

observable_predictions.observable: Maximum absolute dimension error across locked exact controls
observable_predictions.expected_relation: The retained refinement series reaches error below 0.02 without a worsening terminal trend.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Run box-counting and comparison estimators on Cantor, Sierpinski, Koch, and nonfractal controls at preregistered resolutions and scale windows.

falsification_thresholds: Falsify convergence if maximum absolute error remains at or above 0.02 at the terminal preregistered resolution.
Falsify scale stability if adjacent admissible windows shift the estimate by 0.02 or more.

required_evidence.description: Retained baseline estimator outputs
Exact-dimension refinement series and scale-window sensitivity
Independent clean-environment estimator run

hypotheses.title: Covariant scalar-curvature mechanism
hypotheses.formal_statement: A frozen covariant action with declared fields, units, gauge, background, and boundary data yields ghost-free field equations and a dimensioned observable that differs from GR and minimally coupled scalar controls.

observable_predictions.observable: Named dimensioned curvature or propagation observable on held-out data
observable_predictions.expected_relation: The corrected 95 percent confidence interval excludes both matched controls by the preregistered minimum effect.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Derive and solve all arms at matched resolution, then evaluate the locked observable on held-out cases.

falsification_thresholds: Reject if a ghost, gradient instability, or tachyonic physical mode exists in the declared regime.
Reject if normalized constraints exceed 1e-8 or fail refinement.
Reject if the multiplicity-corrected distinguishing test fails at alpha 0.05.

required_evidence.description: Covariant action, units, fields, gauge, background, and boundaries
Field equations, stress tensor, constraints, and perturbation spectrum
Matched GR, minimal-scalar, and null-source simulations
Held-out dimensioned observable with uncertainty
Independent reproduction of derivation and observable

hypotheses.title: Positive closed-cycle vacuum-device work
hypotheses.formal_statement: A physical device produces positive net useful work over a complete return cycle after electrical, pump, boundary-control, environmental heat, radiative, dissipative, and stored-energy channels are included.

observable_predictions.observable: Net useful cycle work with propagated uncertainty
observable_predictions.expected_relation: The multiplicity-corrected lower 95 percent confidence bound is above zero after three-sigma energy closure.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Calibrate and integrate every energy channel over blinded complete cycles and compare with disabled, classical, and sham controls.

falsification_thresholds: Reject if any declared energy channel is omitted.
Reject if the closure residual exceeds three propagated standard uncertainties.
Reject if the corrected lower 95 percent confidence bound for net work is not above zero in either primary or independent replication.

required_evidence.description: Physical device, return cycle, measurement operators, and complete energy ledger
Calibrated blinded raw cycle data and uncertainty covariance
Disabled, classical, and sham control cycles
Casimir, dynamical-Casimir, and quantum inequality constraints
Independent device and analysis replication

hypotheses.title: Time-crystalline order separated from net energy gain
hypotheses.formal_statement: A specified driven many-body system exhibits locked subharmonic order, while a separate complete period-resolved ledger determines whether net useful work remains positive after drive, heat, storage, and loss terms.

observable_predictions.expected_relation: The response remains locked over the preregistered perturbation range and exceeds all phase-destroying controls.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Measure the locked Fourier component and lifetime for interacting, noninteracting, localization-disabled, off-resonant, and sham-drive arms.

observable_predictions.observable: Net useful work over integer drive periods
observable_predictions.expected_relation: The corrected lower 95 percent confidence bound is above zero after three-sigma energy closure.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Integrate all work, heat, storage, and loss channels over complete periods.

falsification_thresholds: Reject time-crystalline order if the subharmonic response is not locked or is reproduced by phase-destroying controls.
Reject energy amplification if closure exceeds three uncertainties or the corrected lower bound for net period work is not positive.

required_evidence.description: Hamiltonian or open-system generator and period-resolved energy operators
Raw order-parameter and complete energy-channel time series
Interacting and phase-destroying control arms
No-go theorem and discrete time-crystal foundations
Independent order and energy replication

hypotheses.title: Planck-force unification action
hypotheses.formal_statement: A common action containing explicit field content reproduces declared Standard Model and general-relativistic low-energy limits and predicts an observable not implied by their uncoupled combination.

observable_predictions.observable: Preregistered low-energy observable unique to the common action
observable_predictions.expected_relation: The result differs from Standard Model plus general relativity and equal-parameter effective-field-theory controls by the locked minimum effect.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Derive all limits and evaluate the observable under the common action and matched alternatives.

falsification_thresholds: Failure to recover any declared low-energy limit falsifies the model.
Absence of a distinguishing observable leaves c^4/G as dimensional analysis rather than unification evidence.

required_evidence.description: Common action, fields, symmetries, units, and coupling constants
Standard Model and general-relativistic limits plus distinguishing prediction
Equal-capacity alternative theories
Independent analytic and numerical reproduction

hypotheses.title: Typed fold-merge operator
hypotheses.formal_statement: A declared operator F from state space X to state space Y is closed on its domain, has stated regularity and invariants, and produces an observable not equivalent to a coordinate transformation.

observable_predictions.observable: Invariant physical contrast between F and an equivalent coordinate transformation
observable_predictions.expected_relation: The contrast exceeds a preregistered nonzero minimum effect.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Evaluate the same states under F and the matched coordinate-only control.

falsification_thresholds: An undefined domain, codomain, operator law, or observable excludes the claim from testing.
Observational equivalence to the coordinate control falsifies the proposed physical effect.

required_evidence.description: Domain, codomain, topology, measure, operator law, regularity, and invariants
Operational physical state map and observable
Coordinate-equivalence control

hypotheses.title: E7 specificity of a nonhomomorphic Fourier triad selector
hypotheses.formal_statement: The E7 discriminant quadratic-defect mask uses epsilon(k)=(kx+ky) mod 2 and D4=3*(epsilon(k)+epsilon(p)+epsilon(q)) mod 4. E7 specificity requires this mask to differ on at least one locked exact triad from the generic even-checkerboard kernel.

observable_predictions.observable: Mismatch count between the quadratic-defect and generic checkerboard masks
observable_predictions.expected_relation: At least one exact triad differs on each locked square Fourier domain.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Exhaustively enumerate integer triads k+p+q=0 at radii 2, 4, and 8 and compare both masks exactly.

observable_predictions.observable: Paired change in locked flow diagnostics
observable_predictions.expected_relation: Only a selector that survives the exact checkerboard control may proceed to matched dynamical controls.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Run paired simulations with identical initial fields and matched triad-retention rates.

controls: Label-shuffled selector with identical triad-retention rate
Matched radial-spectrum, power, and anisotropy controls
falsification_thresholds: Reject E7 specificity if the quadratic-defect mask is exactly the generic checkerboard kernel.
Reject the replacement if it accepts all or no exact triads on any locked evaluation domain.
Reject the claimed symmetry if any exact rotation or reflection test fails.
Reject a dynamical advantage unless corrected paired confidence bounds exceed the preregistered minimum effect against every matched control.

required_evidence.description: Typed nonhomomorphic selector and explicit statement that it is not an E7 root charge
Exact Cartan inverse, discriminant value, selector counts, and declared lattice symmetries
Generic parity-kernel dynamics only after conservation gates
Exact generic-checkerboard equivalence control
Identity, homomorphism, alternative parity, and equal-rate shuffled controls
Cache-isolated clean-environment rerun

hypotheses.title: Kac-Moody current-to-fluid dictionary
hypotheses.formal_statement: A typed map from declared Kac-Moody currents and a Sugawara stress tensor to dimensioned fluid variables satisfies the Ward identities and yields a dispersion relation that outperforms a spectrum- and power-matched label-shuffled forcing control.

observable_predictions.observable: Residual of the derived dispersion relation and paired flow diagnostic effect
observable_predictions.expected_relation: Ward and dispersion residuals pass exact or locked numerical tolerances and the flow effect exceeds the matched control.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Evaluate the typed dictionary symbolically, then run paired forcing with identical spectra and injected power.

controls: Label-shuffled forcing with identical spectrum and power
falsification_thresholds: Any failed type, unit, or Ward-identity check falsifies the declared dictionary.
A paired effect interval overlapping the equivalence margin falsifies transfer specificity.

required_evidence.description: Currents, representation level, stress tensor, fluid variables, units, and map
Ward identities and fluid dispersion relation
Matched forcing experiment
Independent symbolic and numerical reproduction

hypotheses.title: Transient beta-dependent zonalization of freely decaying turbulence
hypotheses.formal_statement: In the declared dealiased barotropic beta-plane solver without sustained forcing, beta equal to 5 and 10 increases final-window zonal energy fraction and persistent-jet prevalence relative to paired beta-zero controls across preregistered drag, viscosity, and seed cells.

observable_predictions.observable: Paired final-window mean zonal energy fraction difference versus beta zero
observable_predictions.expected_relation: For beta 5 and 10, the Holm-adjusted exact sign-flip p-value is below 0.05, the simultaneous lower 95 percent confidence bound is above zero, and the estimated difference is at least 0.05.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Use seed-paired, drag-paired, and viscosity-paired production runs with exact seed-cluster sign flips and Bonferroni-simultaneous bootstrap intervals.

observable_predictions.observable: Paired persistent-jet prevalence difference versus beta zero
observable_predictions.expected_relation: For beta 5 and 10, the Holm-adjusted exact sign-flip p-value is below 0.05, the simultaneous lower 95 percent confidence bound is above zero, and the estimated difference is at least 0.50.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Apply fixed circular peak diagnostics over the final 25 percent of every run.

falsification_thresholds: A run is persistent only when final-window mean and 10th-percentile zonal fractions are at least 0.10, modal jet count is at least 2, and modal-count occupancy is at least 0.80.

Reject numerical admission if normalized energy or enstrophy residual exceeds 1e-6, time-step change is at least 2 percent, grid change is at least 5 percent, or refined jet count differs by more than one.
Reject the primary claim unless both beta 5 and beta 10 pass the Holm-adjusted sign-flip tests, simultaneous confidence bounds, and minimum effects for both endpoints.

required_evidence.description: Locked decaying-turbulence protocol, parameter matrix, diagnostics, and multiplicity plan
Existing short beta-response and homomorphic-filter negative-control ablation
Production sweep, refinement runs, tracked time series, profiles, and normalized budget residuals
F-plane, transpose, synthetic-positive, LBM-null, and quotient-sentinel controls
Cache-isolated clean-environment rerun

hypotheses.title: Tourmaline response beyond conventional constitutive models
hypotheses.formal_statement: After fitting conventional pyroelectric, piezoelectric, dielectric, thermal, triboelectric, vibrational, and electromagnetic responses on calibration data, blinded tourmaline cycles retain a positive novelty residual and closed excess-energy balance.

observable_predictions.observable: Held-out residual charge, voltage, current, or work beyond the conventional constitutive model
observable_predictions.expected_relation: The Holm-corrected lower 95 percent confidence bound exceeds the preregistered minimum effect while energy closure remains within three uncertainties.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Calibrate stress, temperature, charge, voltage, current, and vibration; lock the model; then evaluate blind material and orientation arms.

falsification_thresholds: Reject novelty if the conventional model explains the held-out response within the locked equivalence margin.
Reject an energy claim if any channel is omitted or closure exceeds three propagated standard uncertainties.
Reject promotion unless the corrected effect survives independent replication.

required_evidence.description: Composition, orientation, geometry, electrodes, cycle, operators, and conventional constitutive model
Calibrated blinded raw cycles and complete energy ledger
Axis, nonpolar, reference-material, and dummy-fixture arms
Independent material, apparatus, and analysis replication

hypotheses.title: Operational biological endpoint for consciousness resonance
hypotheses.formal_statement: A declared intervention and dose produce a preregistered change in an operational biological endpoint under a causal model and blinded matched comparator.

observable_predictions.expected_relation: The corrected effect exceeds the locked minimum effect and replicates independently.
observable_predictions.measurement_method: Apply randomized blinded intervention and comparator assignments under a declared causal model.

falsification_thresholds: An undefined intervention, dose, endpoint, or causal model excludes the claim from testing.
A preregistered null or control-equivalent response falsifies the declared effect.

required_evidence.description: Intervention, dose, endpoint, causal model, comparator, and minimum effect
Ethically approved blinded raw data
Sham, dose-zero, and nonspecific controls
Independent preregistered replication
